dr suspension.note:
Take exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not take in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended. Follow the directions on your prescription.

For oral use only. Shake the oral suspension (liquid) well just before you measure a dose. Measure the liquid with a special dose-measuring spoon or medicine cup.

Use this medication for the full prescribed length of time. Store the syrup/mixture at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light. Throw away any unused medication after 14 days.

How to prepare the suspension:

Tap the bottle several times to loosen powder contents prior to reconstitution. Add 60 ml (with the help of provided cup) of boiled and cooled water to the bottle. Then continue shaking the bottle gently until the powder mixed properly.

Shake the suspension well before each use. Keep the bottle tightly closed. The reconstituted suspension should be stored in a cool and dry place, preferably in refrigerator and unused portion should be discarded after 14 days.
dr suspension.noteBn:

এই স্যালাইন বা ইনজেকশান সাধারণত রক্ত নালিতে আইভি ক্যানুলার  সাহায্যে দেয়া হয়। একজন ডাক্তার বা নার্স এটি আপনাকে দিবেন। সিরিঞ্জ ও সুইটি একবার ব্যাবহারের জন্য, ব্যাবহারের পর সেটি নির্দিষ্ট স্থানে ফেলে দিন।

injection for infusion.note:
Use exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not use in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended. Follow the directions on your prescription label.

 

It is injected into a vein through an IV needle/cannula. It is usually administered as an injection at your doctor's office, hospital, or clinic by a doctor, nurse, or other healthcare professional. Keep this product, as well as syringes and needles, out of the reach of children. Do not reuse needles, syringes, or other materials. Dispose of properly after use.

resperitory solution.note:
To use the solution with a nebulizer:

Open the foil pouch and remove one vial. Squeeze all of the medicine out into the chamber of the nebulizer.

Attach the mouthpiece or face mask to the drug chamber. Then, attach the drug chamber to the compressor. Sit upright in a comfortable position. Place the mouthpiece into your mouth or put the face mask on, covering your nose and mouth.

Breathe in slowly and evenly until you have inhaled all of the medicine (usually 5 to 15 minutes). The treatment is complete when no more mist is formed by the nebulizer and the drug chamber is empty.

Clean the nebulizer after each use. Follow the cleaning directions that came with your nebulizer.

liquid cleanser.note:
.         Apply a palmful of the product in a cupped hand and cover all surfaces.

·         Rub hands palm to palm right palm over left dorsum with interlaced fingers and vice versa.

·         Then palm to palm with fingers interlaced.

·         Backs of fingers to opposing palms with fingers interlocked.

·         Rotational rubbing of left thumb, clasped in right palm and vice versa.

·         Rotational rubbing, backwards and forwards with clasped fingers of right hand in left palm and vice versa.

·         Rinse hands with water & dry thoroughly with a towel.

·         Once dry, your hands are safe.
liquid cleanser.noteBn:
• হ্যান্ড রাবটি হাতের তালুতে পরিমান মত নিয়ে, দুই হাতের পুরা তালুতে প্রয়োগ করুন।

• এরপর ডান হাতের তালু ও আঙ্গুল দিয়ে বাম হাতের উপর অংশ ও আঙুলের মাঝের অংশে প্রয়োগ করুন, এভাবে একই ভাবে বাম হাতের তালু দিয়ে ডান হাতের উপর আঙুলে প্রয়োগ করুন ।   

• আঙ্গুলের সাথে আঙ্গুলের সামনে পিছনের অংশে প্রয়োগ করুন।

• তারপর একটি টাওয়েল দিয়ে শুকিয়ে নিন।

• শুকিয়ে যাবার পর, আপনার হাত নিরাপদ।

How to use your Dry powder inhaler (DPI)
Dry powder inhalers (DPI) are filled with powdered medicine that is inhaled into the lungs.
For the capsule aerolizer DPI, the powder comes in a capsule that is punctured before inhaling.
You must inhale fast and deep to pull the medicine out of the holder and deep into your lungs.

Open the plastic medicine holder.
Open the capsule from the foil wrap and place the entire capsule in the bottom of the holder.
Close the holder.
Breathe out and press the side buttons once to puncture the capsule to release the powder.
Seal your lips over the mouth piece.
Inhale at a medium speed. You will hear the capsule “rattle” in the bottom.
Hold your breath for 10 seconds.
Repeat few times and breathe easy until capsule is not empty.

Dry powder inhalers (DPI) are filled with powdered medicine that is inhaled into the lungs.
For the capsule aerolizer DPI, the powder comes in a capsule that is punctured before inhaling.
You must inhale fast and deep to pull the medicine out of the holder and deep into your lungs.

Open the plastic medicine holder.
Open the capsule from the foil wrap and place the entire capsule in the bottom of the holder.
Close the holder.
Breathe out and press the side buttons once to puncture the capsule to release the powder.
Seal your lips over the mouth piece.
Inhale at a medium speed. You will hear the capsule “rattle” in the bottom.
Hold your breath for 10 seconds.
Repeat few times and breathe easy until capsule is not empty.
Open the holder and throw away the empty capsule.

topical suspension.note:
Use exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not use this medicine in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended.

Do not take by mouth. Topical preparation’s is for use only on the skin/scalp.

Wash your hands before and after applying this medicine. Shake the lotion/solution form of this medicine well just before you use it. At first wash the face or affected area gently with warm water or soap. Pat the skin dry with a clean towel. Apply the medication in a thin layer to the entire face or other affected skin areas and rub it in completely. Do not apply any other skin products unless your doctor has told you to.

 

Do not cover treated skin areas with a bandage or tight clothing, unless your doctor has told you to.  Keep the tube or bottle capped and tightly closed when not in use.

ইহা শুধুমাত্র বাহ্যিক ত্বকে ব্যাবহারের জন্য। ক্ষতস্থা্নে বা আক্রান্ত স্থানে যেখানে ওশুধটি লাগানো হবে সেটি পরিস্কার ও শুষ্ক করুন। ব্যাবহার করার আগে ওশুধটি কয়েকবার ঝাঁকিয়ে নিন। এরপর হালকা ভাবে জেল বা লোশানটি অল্প করে আঙুলের মাথায় বা হাতের তালুতে নিয়ে  ক্ষতস্থানে লাগান। ওষুধটি ব্যাবহারের পর হাত ধুয়ে ফেলুন।

ডাক্তারের পরামর্শ ছাড়া ক্ষতস্থানটি ওষুধ লাগানোর পর ব্যান্ডেজ বা তুলা দিয়ে ঢাকা যাবেনা। ব্যাবহারের পর বোতলের মুখটি শক্ত ভাবে আটকিয়ে রাখুন।

mouth wash.note:
To use as a mouthwash or gargle, measure your dose using the cup provided with the medication. Hold the medicine in your mouth for at least 30 seconds, then spit it out. Do not swallow the mouthwash.

Some oral rinse should generally be used undiluted, but if you find it makes your mouth sting you can dilute it with an equal volume of water before use.
mouth wash.noteBn:

pen cartridge.note:
Use exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not use this medicine in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended. Do not change your medication dose or schedule without your doctor's advice.

Insulin is injected under the skin. Choose a different place in your injection skin area each time you use this medication. Do not inject into the same place two times in a row.

Storing unopened vials and cartridges: Keep in the carton and store in a refrigerator, protected from light. Storing after your first use: Keep the "in-use" vials or cartridges at cool room temperature. Throw away any insulin not used within 31 days.

Do not freeze insulin, and throw away the medication if it has become frozen. Once you start using an injection pen or prefilled syringe, do not keep it in a refrigerator. Store it at room temperature. Store the injection pen with its cap on.

Use exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not use in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended.

Topical preparation is use only on the skin. Clean and dry the affected area. Apply a small amount of the cream/ointment. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine.

Do not cover the treated skin area unless your doctor tells you to. Avoid using bandages or dressings that do not allow air circulation.

ইহা শুধুমাত্র বাহ্যিক ত্বকে ব্যাবহারের জন্য। ক্ষতস্থা্নে বা আক্রান্ত স্থানে যেখানে ওশুধটি লাগানো হবে সেটি পরিস্কার ও শুষ্ক করুন। এরপর হালকা ভাবে মলম বা লোশানটি অল্প করে আঙুলের মাথায় বা হাতের তালুতে নিয়ে  ক্ষতস্থানে লাগান। ওষুধটি ব্যাবহারের পর হাত ধুয়ে ফেলুন।

ডাক্তারের পরামর্শ ছাড়া ক্ষতস্থানটি মলম লাগানোর পর ব্যান্ডেজ বা তুলা দিয়ে ঢাকা যাবেনা।

Shake the bottle before adding water. Then add 10 ml (or with the help of provided spoon) of boiled and cooled water. Then continuously shake the bottle well until the powder mixed properly. Measure liquid medicine with a special dose-measuring dropper. Shake the bottle well before each use.

Store at room temperature away from moisture and heat. Do not allow the liquid form of this medicine to freeze.

খাবার আগে তরল ওশুধের বোতলটি কয়েকবার ভালোভাবে ঝাঁকিয়ে নিন।এরপর বোতলের সাথে দেয়া ড্রপারের সাহায্যে নির্দিষ্ট পরিমান ওষুধ মেপে বাচ্চাকে খাওয়াতে হবে।  

সাস্পেনশান তৈরির জন্য পাউডার যুক্ত বোতলে নির্দিষ্ট পরিমান ফুটানো ঠান্ডা পানি ঢালুন এবং বোতলের ক্যাপটি লাগিয়ে ভালোভাবে ঝাঁকিয়ে পাউডারটি মিশান। ব্যাবহারের জন্য সাস্পেনশান্টি তৈরি হয়ে গেলো। বোতলটি ঘরের তাপমাত্রায় আলো ও তাপ থেকে দূরে ঘরের ঠান্ডা স্থানে রাখুন।

paediatric nasal drops.note:
Use exactly as directed on the label, or as prescribed by your doctor. Do not use in larger or smaller amounts or for longer than recommended.

 

To use the nose drops:

Blow your nose gently. Tilt your head back as far as possible, or lie down and hang your head over the side of a bed. Hold the dropper over your nose and place the correct number of drops into your nose.

Sit up and bend your head slightly forward, then move it gently left and right. Stay seated with your head bent forward for a few minutes.

Avoid sneezing or blowing your nose for at least a few minutes after using the nose drops.

To use the nasal spray:

Blow your nose gently. Keep your head upright and insert the tip of bottle into one nostril. Press your other nostril closed with your finger. Breathe in quickly and gently spray the medicine into your nose. Then use the spray in your other nostril.

Do not blow your nose for at least a few minutes after using the nasal spray.

Store at room temperature away from moisture and heat. Do not freeze. Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use.

ব্যাবহারের পর বোতলের মুখটি শক্ত ভাবে আটকিয়ে রাখুন এবং বোতলটি ঘরের ঠান্ডা স্থানে রাখুন। তাপ ও আলো থেকে দূরে রাখুন।
